full_prompt_en: A square watercolor landscape sets a small yellow farmhouse on the right beneath enormous rolling storm clouds. The house has a steep roof, dark windows and a narrow porch, sitting beyond a pale path that bends through low shrubs and an open field. A bare black tree stands left of center, its branches stretching up into the cloud mass. At the far left, pale ground and a thin horizon keep the scene open despite the weight of the sky. The clouds fill more than half the frame, built from repeating scalloped lobes in white, lavender gray and charcoal. They pile upward and outward until the upper right nearly turns black. Smaller bushes in blue green and yellow dot the foreground, while the road remains a quiet light ribbon leading to the house. The palette is selective: yellow walls and a few golden plants glow against cool grays and muted green. The light is diffuse, as if the cloudbank filters the sun, but the building remains the brightest warm form. Crisp ink-like outlines define the tree and house, while soft washes and carefully repeated curved marks shape the clouds. The image feels charged with weather, holding the still homestead against a sky that seems to swell and move. Strong vertical branching and cloud curls give the otherwise simple rural composition an animated rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形水彩风景把一座小黄农舍放在右侧巨大的翻卷暴风云下。屋顶陡斜，窗户深暗，门前有窄廊，房子位于一条浅色小路尽头；小路穿过低矮灌木和开阔田地弯向远处。一棵黑色枯树立于中央偏左，枝条伸进云团。极左侧浅色地面与细地平线使画面在沉重天空下仍有开阔感。云占据超过半幅画，以白、薰衣草灰和炭灰的重复扇贝形团块构成，向上向外堆叠，直到右上角近乎黑色。蓝绿和黄色小灌丛点在前景，道路是一条安静的浅色带，引向房子。配色节制：黄色墙面和几株金色植物在冷灰与柔和绿中发光。光漫散，像阳光被云层过滤，但房子仍是最明亮的暖形。近似墨线的清晰轮廓界定树和屋，柔软水洗与反复的弧形笔记塑造云层。天气的力量充满画面，静止居所与似乎膨胀流动的天空相持。强烈竖向枝条和云涡让简单乡村构图有了活跃节奏。
style_prompt_en: The watercolor uses pale washes, crisp dark contours and repeated curling marks. Cool lavender gray, white and charcoal gather in large swelling masses, while selective yellow and muted blue green accents keep the lower field alive. Diffuse light gives broad soft values, but a few edges remain sharply inked. The composition places a small warm focal shape beneath a much larger moving pattern. Branching silhouettes and scalloped rhythms create a charged, almost musical sense of weather.
style_prompt_zh: 这种水彩使用浅色水洗、清楚暗轮廓和重复卷曲笔记。冷薰衣草灰、白与炭黑聚成巨大鼓胀的色块，少量黄色与低饱和蓝绿点缀使下方色域保持活力。漫射光带来宽阔柔和明度，但部分边缘仍像墨线般锐利。构图把小小暖色焦点压在更庞大的流动图案下。分枝剪影与扇贝状节奏营造出充满张力、近乎音乐性的天气感。
theme_en: A yellow farmhouse beneath towering storm clouds
theme_zh: 高耸暴风云下的黄色农舍
name: Charles E. Burchfield
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
